Settlement model

How Handshake settles across chains without a bridge, and what each state actually guarantees.

What the dashboard reads

This is a read-only operator surface. It never drives settlement — no write path exists in the UI.

Settlement lookups by id read HandshakeASC.getHandshake on Creditcoin plus the two lock contracts directly. Nothing is inferred: a proof is reported verified only when the coordinator holds a non-zero commitment for it, because the contract writes those commitments strictly after verification succeeds. Aggregate views — the index, metrics, and activity feed — are sample-backed and labelled as such, because the coordinator exposes no enumeration and the public testnet RPC rejects the log ranges an index would require.

State machine

StateGuarantee
PREPAREAwaiting both legs. Locks remain fully reversible.
READYBoth legs verified. The bounded commit window is open.
COMMITIrreversible COMMIT executed on Creditcoin.
SETTLEDBoth native legs finalized and attested.
HELDPre-commit timeout expired. Unilateral refund is available.

Settlement parameters

Coordinator chain
Creditcoin Testnet (102031)
Attested source chain
Ethereum Sepolia (11155111)
Finality buffer
12 confirmations on Ethereum Sepolia
Timeout window
60 minutes from PREPARE, and again from READY
COMMIT location
Creditcoin only. No source chain has an independent commit transaction.
Recovery
Timeout-driven and unilateral. Requires no attestor signature and no counterparty cooperation.

Connecting the dashboard to chain

Without these the settlement index still renders from sample data, but live lookups by id are disabled.

web/.env.local
# Public, read-only values. Safe to expose — they are inlined into the browser
# bundle. Never put a signer key behind a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix.
NEXT_PUBLIC_CREDITCOIN_RPC_URL=https://rpc.cc3-testnet.creditcoin.network
NEXT_PUBLIC_ETHEREUM_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL=https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com
NEXT_PUBLIC_HANDSHAKE_ASC_ADDRESS=0x905E0f141D8B5333F49755B08395d1beAdEd74Ab
NEXT_PUBLIC_CREDITCOIN_LOCK_ADDRESS=0xb3e9cB40A52EF777A29b6198f4c2D8d19893a01D
NEXT_PUBLIC_ETHEREUM_LOCK_ADDRESS=0x999326d027316C6CD0156a39ac8d3792f2EFC802
